operations.description: This API is used to delete applications from a project in batches.
This API is used to delete hosts from a host cluster in batches.
This API is used to modify application permissions in batches.
This API is used to configure the authentication level to project-level or instance-level for applications in batches.
This API is used to check whether the current user has the permission to create applications in a project.
This API is used to check whether an application with the same name exists in a project.
This API is used to check whether the current user has permissions to create a host cluster in a project.
This API is used to clone an application.
This API is used to clone hosts to the target host cluster in batches.
Create an application.
This API is used to create a group.
Customizes a template to create an application. This interface will no longer be maintained after September 30, 2024. You are advised to use the CreateApp interface of the new version.
Create a host cluster in the project. This interface will no longer be maintained after September 30, 2024. You are advised to use the CreateHostCluster interface of the new version.
Create a host in a specified host cluster. This interface will no longer be maintained after September 30, 2024. You are advised to use the CreateHost interface of the new version.
Creating an Environment in an Application.
Create a host in host cluster.
Create a host cluster in the project.
This API is used to delete a group.
Deleting an application by application ID.

Deletes an application based on the deployment task ID. This interface will no longer be maintained after September 30, 2024. You are advised to use the DeleteApplication interface of the new version.
This interface is used to delete a host cluster based on the host cluster ID. This interface will no longer be maintained after September 30, 2024.
This interface is used to delete a host based on the host ID. This interface will no longer be maintained after September 30, 2024.
Deleting an Environment from an Application.
This API is used to delete a host from a host cluster by ID.
This API is used to delete a host cluster.
Deleting a Host From Environment.
Importing Hosts to an Environment.
Querying the Application List in a Project.
This API is used to query a group list.

This API is used to query the instance-level or project-level permission matrix of an application. If app_id is transferred, the instance-level permission matrix is queried. If project_id is transferred while app_id is not transferred, the project-level permission matrix is queried.
This API is used to query information about the environment associated with a host cluster.
Queries the historical execution records of a specified task in a project based on the start time and end time.
Querying the application list in a project. This interface will no longer be maintained after September 30, 2024. You are advised to use the ListAllApp interface of the new version.
This API is used to query a host list in an environment.
This API is used to query environment permissions.
Querying the Environment List of an Application.
This interface is used to query the host cluster list based on conditions.
This API is used to query the basic environment information list of an application.
This API is used to query the permission matrix of a host cluster by ID.

This interface is used to query the host cluster list based on conditions. This interface will no longer be maintained after September 30, 2024. You are advised to use the ListHostClusters interface of the new version.

This interface is used to query the list of hosts in a specified host cluster based on the host cluster ID. This interface will no longer be maintained after September 30, 2024. You are advised to use the ListNewHosts interface of the new version.
Query host list by host cluster ID.
Obtains the application deployment success rate of a specified application.
This API is used to move a group up or down to adjust the position of the group on the page.
This API is used to move applications to a specified group (batch operations are supported).
Query application detail by application ID.

Obtains application details based on the deployment task ID. This interface will no longer be maintained after September 30, 2024. You are advised to use the ShowAppDetailById interface of the new version.

This interface is used to query details about a host cluster based on the host cluster ID. This interface will no longer be maintained after September 30, 2024. You are advised to use the ShowHostClusterDetail interface of the new version.

This interface is used to query host details based on the host ID. This interface will no longer be maintained after September 30, 2024. You are advised to use the ShowHostDetail interface of the new version.
Querying environment details.
Querying execution parameters of a deployment record.
Query host cluster detail by host cluster ID.
Query host details by host ID.
Obtains the application deployment success rate of a specified project.
Deploys an application based on the deployment task ID.
This API is used to disable or enable an application.
This API is used to modify a group.
This API is used to update an application.
This interface is used to modify host cluster information based on the host cluster ID. This interface will no longer be maintained after September 30, 2024.
This interface is used to modify host information based on the host ID. This interface will no longer be maintained after September 30, 2024.
This API is used to edit an environment in an application.
This API is used to edit the environment permission.
This API is used to edit a host cluster.
This API is used to modify the permission matrix of a host cluster by ID.
This API is used to edit host information in a host cluster by ID.
